sloka: ततो दूरात्प्रददृशे धनाध्यक्षो गदाधरः ।शुक्रप्रौष्ठपदाभ्यां च पद्मशङ्खसमावृतः ।। ७.१५.१६ ॥
transliteration: tato dūrātpradadṛśe dhanādhyakṣo gadādharaḥ ।śukraprauṣṭhapadābhyāṁ ca padmaśaṅkhasamāvṛtaḥ ।। 7.15.16 ॥

translations.english: Then, from afar, the mace-wielding lord of wealth (Kubera) was seen, accompanied by Shukra and Praushthapada, and surrounded by Padma and Shankha.
